listing.name: Takeshido v1.1.1
listing.aiSummary: Adds over 70 racecars, a racing faction with planets and ships, and a full racing gamemode with betting and tournaments.

description: Adds over 70 racecars that function as both racecars and combat units with custom AI. Includes a new faction with three planets, unique ships, and theme music. Features a racing gamemode allowing players to bet on races, participate in impromptu events, or join multi-track grand prix tournaments across over 25 replicated real-life racetracks.

changelog.1.1.1:
-Races now occur on the planets that the tracks are on. They use a tiled bachground with a bunch of tricks to make it not boring, but all assets are unloaded when the race ends, so your vram should not be meaningfully affected.
-Slightly nerfed the escudo
changelog.1.1.0:
Cars can now no longer equip hullmods that affect their engines or speed, however, to compensate for this I have added in a new tuning shop available on all takeshido planets.
Fixed a bug where the game would sometimes crash when pressing several other keys while drifting.
5 new cars.
30 new npc drivers.
races are now all 2 laps, however, tracks are also smaller.
split races into more tiers to account for the fact that npc cars can now have tuner shop upgrades and therefore fill out the other tiers better.

conflicts.name: Epta
conflicts.quote: It should be compatible with Epta in the sense that it won't crash, however, I would not recommend using the two together.
